task: Identify the cause of repeated stale report output and select one discriminating test.

observations.summary: The report task failed after the source advanced.
An unchanged replay produced the same stale revision.

hypothesis_options.statement: The caching proxy reuses revision A because its key omits the source revision.
The report worker reads a stale source-store view at revision A.
The verifier reads a previous artifact containing revision A.

test_options.question: What revision appears after an unchanged replay?
What revision appears when the caching proxy is bypassed?
What revision does a direct worker response contain?
What revision is verified through a fresh artifact path?
